scope: Live normal-Survival follow-up in the existing isolated Blockwire Endportal Survival world. One observed inventory gain after native mining; not general terrain navigation, Nether progression or an uninterrupted playthrough.
operator_authorization: Death explicitly permitted for this development live test. F8, TLS, actor fences, input leases and cleanup retained.

prior_trials.subsequent_wood_attempt: timed_out after 10 cooperative seconds; no inventory gain

change: Require a cardinally adjacent supported standing cell instead of a diagonal cell. Diagonal mining reach does not establish native pickup proximity. Added WD11 contract and a killed regression mutation.
limitations: Raw native descent was explicitly risky, caused five damage, and is not implemented or qualified as a reusable terrain-navigation skill.
The successful trial was a separately inspected activation after descent and a failed ground attempt; it was not an autonomous recovery loop.
The successful target differed from the prior pickup failure; this is not a controlled A/B proof of the standing-position change.
Inventory gain confirms collection, not exact attribution of the item to the last block versus a previously dropped log.
No commands, teleports, item spawning, automatic respawn or weakening of the gather_wood damage/flat-ground guards.
Crafting, portal construction, Nether travel, dragon combat and no-pause completion remain unimplemented/unverified.
